newsitem.title: USA: HF Financial adopts shareholder plan.
newsitem.headline: HF Financial adopts shareholder plan.

text.p: HF Financial Corp said its board on Thursday adopted a shareholder rights plan aimed at making sure any attempted takeover of the company gives a fair value to shareholders.
The plan gives common stock holders of record on November 13 a purchase right that would be triggered by an attempted acquisition of 20 percent or more of HF's common stock.

On exercise, the right allows the holder to buy common shares with a value double that of the right, or to buy securities of the acquiring company at one-half their market value at that time. No price of the right was given.
HF is the holding company for Home Federal Savings Bank of Sioux Falls, S.S., and HF Mortgage Corp of Omaha, Neb.
